newsitem.title: UK: Sweden eyes seven-year dollar Eurobond - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Sweden eyes seven-year dollar Eurobond - dealers.

text.p: Sweden could issue a seven-year dollar Eurobond for up to $500 million, bankers said on Wednesday.
"There are rumours Sweden is eyeing a seven-year deal, for up to $500 million," a dealer at a European bank said.
Another Eurobond trader said a smaller issue of around $300 million was being considered by Sweden.
"There is demand at seven years," a syndicate manager at a U.S. bank said. "Swiss investors in particular are extending maturities from five to seven years, and Sweden could tap into this arbitrage."
Spread talk on the deal was around 20 basis points over five-year U.S. Treasury notes, dealers said. No mandate had yet been awarded for the issue, they said.
